audit.why: Tricky assassin lane: Sylas wins pre-6 trading, Naafiri owns 6-through-first-item, Sylas retakes late in grouped fights. Matches kits and 50.59% WR over 7494 games.

audit.corrected: All seven full-layer sides moved to match content/packet, with grounded whys and adjusted ratings; win[N] already correct so no content chart edits.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content layer calls her ult 'R Call of the Pack' (that is her W's name) and calls her W dash 'W The Hunt' (a name she does not have; her dash is E Eviscerate, her lock-on ult is Hounds' Pursuit). Many pronoun errors; cooldowns field has no digits; trade strings are the lane template.
audit.why: Kit authority: Q Darkin Daggers, W The Call of the Pack (untargetable, 26-18s), E Eviscerate (dash, heals packmates, 11-7s), R Hounds' Pursuit (900-range lock-on dash, shield on recast, 110/95/80s).
audit.corrected: Fabricated/misassigned names replaced with kit names; cooldowns field now carries 110/95/80 and 26-18s; pronouns corrected; trades grounded in W-untargetability bait and R lock-on threat.

audit.why: Anti-heal note exists in report[8] (her E recalls and heals packmates — the missing-interactions rule); kept, pronoun fixed.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 stay in your favour on pure trading, but at 6 the lane tilts to Naafiri. Her R Call of the Pack is a lethal engage tool — bonus move speed, extra dogs, and healing that lets her dive you through a single E Abscond. From 6 through her first lethality item, respect that all-in window: don't shove blindly, hold E to dodge her W The Hunt dash, and back off if she ults with jungler nearby. This is her strongest stretch of the matchup.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 stay in your favour on pure trading, but at 6 the lane tilts to Naafiri. Her R Hounds' Pursuit is a lethal lock-on engage — the pack dashes with her and the recast shields her, letting her dive you through a single E Abscond. From 6 through her first lethality item, respect that all-in window: don't shove blindly, hold E until her W untargetability is spent, and back off if she ults with jungler nearby. This is her strongest stretch of the matchup.

notes: Content layer used two wrong ability names: 'R Call of the Pack' (her W's name applied to her ult — the ult is Hounds' Pursuit) and 'W The Hunt' (no such Naafiri ability; her dash is E Eviscerate). All replaced from the kit. Full-layer level chart was fully inverted vs content+packet; all seven sides realigned with rewritten whys and ratings — win[N] untouched because it was already correct on every row. Five report[] entries edited beyond the two-entry guideline: all were lint-flagged misgenders (report[1], [8], [9], [11]) or had to stay in sync with corrected trade strings (report[3]); none is a sweep rewrite. R lock-on 'cannot be kited but can be minion-blocked' claim kept from existing page wording; hound body-block detail was already on the page and is consistent with Riot's projectile pack behaviour.
